value.name: ISSS Scholarships for International Students (Texas Global)

scholarship_exists.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 and 2027-2028 academic year scholarships will be accepted February 1, 2027 - March 1, 2027
scholarship_exists.notes: Texas Global, International Student and Scholar Services (ISSS) page 'Scholarships for International Students'. Fall-term / academic-year awards listed for 2027-28 include the International Education Fee Scholarship (eligibility: 'undergraduate or graduate student enrolled full-time at UT Austin during the award semester'), the STEM Scholarship ($4,800 fall tuition award; Cockrell engineering or College of Natural Sciences; preference for students from Mexico), the African Leadership Bridge Endowed Scholarship ($5,000 plus a nonresident-tuition waiver; 'Preference will be given to an incoming first-year student' but 'You must be an undergraduate student currently enrolled at UT Austin'), the Iimura Peace Endowed Scholarship ($5,000; schooling in East Asia or Asia) and others. Several awards require 'completed an entire course of study for two academic semesters at UT Austin' (General ISSS Financial Aid, Jerry D. Wilcox, SIAWE), so an incoming first-year can apply to few of them. Applications through LASSO; one-time awards, competitive. This replaces the base 'incoming' award (onestop.utexas.edu) for this question if merged, because kb_build merges scholarship_exists as one unit; see README.

scholarship_international.quote: Scholarships for International Students Certain scholarship opportunities are open to international students who meet eligibility criteria.
scholarship_international.notes: Same ISSS page. Open to international students who meet each award's criteria; many require two completed semesters at UT Austin, and several are restricted by region of schooling (Mexico, Iran, Africa, Asia, Middle East). Whether a given incoming first-year is eligible depends on the individual award; amounts are fixed per award ($2,000-$5,000), not a full-cost award.
